name: Gout of Flame
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level adept 1, bloodrager 1, druid 1, magus 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Range 30 ft.
Effect 30-foot-line gout of flame
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

You spray a long gout of flame from your fingertips engulfing your foe.

While the spell is a 30-foot line, only the closest target to you is affected in each round.

The affected target must make a Reflex save or be dealt 1d6 + 1 per caster level (max +5) fire damage. You may elect to exclude the square adjacent to you from the area of effect if you so choose. These flames can ignite flammable materials and any creature that fails their Reflex save against this spell two rounds in a row catches fire as per the environmental rules in the Pathfinder Core Rulebook. If the target is already on fire, this spell only deals 1 damage per caster level (max 5) but the target is unable to roll the Reflex save to put out the fire on themselves during that round. Each round while concentrating on the spell, you may redirect the line of effect.
